name: WARSIM (The Warfighter's Simulation)
description: U.S. Army battalion-and-below constructive simulation for command post training and mission rehearsal. Models platoon-to-battalion operations with emergent force-on-force dynamics. Used at home station and combat training centers to support collective training and battle staff development.
general_score_metric: mission_success_rate / outcome-based metrics (e.g., training objective attainment, force effectiveness measures)
reputation: U.S. Army institutional simulation used at brigade and below level for collective training and battle staff exercises
notes: Designed to complement OneSAF at the battalion and below echelon. Supports command post exercises (CPX) and fire support coordination training. Primarily used at U.S. Army installations.

institutions: U.S. Army Program Executive Office for Simulation, Training and Instrumentation (PEO STRI)
